source: maplestory.io (GMS 270) — skillbook API + raw WZ API
notes: Frames listed with placeholder=true are 1x1 timing placeholders in the source WZ data; the player skips them.
Job 301 is Pathfinder ("The Archer's Art"), not an Explorer Bowman line — out of scope for this branch; see the Pathfinder worker.
Job 300 ("Bowman Basics") skills are shared by the Bowmaster and Marksman lines and appear in both folders.
Guided Arrow, Vicious Shot and Fury of the Wild are shared Bowman 5th-job skills and appear in both the Bowmaster and Marksman folders.

Jobs 314/324 are the 6th-job (HEXA) skillbooks, not Hyper files: HEXA actives (HEXA Hurricane etc.) plus the 6th-job active skills (Bowmaster: Ascendant Shadow, Flashpoint; Marksman: Final Aim, Fatal Trigger).
Sol Janus / Sol Hecate (common 6th-job origin skills) were not located in Skill/40000.img or Skill/40003.img in GMS 270; same gap as Hero.

skills.name: Crossbow Mastery
skills.description: Increases Crossbow Mastery and Final Damage.

skills.name: Final Attack : Crossbow
skills.description: When a direct attack skill lands, there's a chance to trigger additional hits. Must have a crossbow equipped.

skills.name: Physical Training
skills.description: Permanently increases STR and DEX through sheer physical training.

skills.name: Agile Crossbows
skills.description: Increases Attack Speed and Dexterity.

skills.name: Soul Arrow: Crossbow
skills.description: Allows you to fire your crossbow without consuming arrows and increases Attack Power.\nThe crossbow arrows in your inventory with the highest Attack Power will be used to calculate damage.

skills.name: Piercing Arrow
skills.description: Fires an arrow. Its effect increases with each enemy it hits.

skills.name: Covering Fire
skills.description: Fire arrows while leaping backwards. While firing, you'll have 100% Knockback Resistance. If you press and hold the skill key, you will fire arrows rapidly while in mid-air. You will temporarily not be pushed back by any attack after casting.

skills.name: Swift Surge
skills.description: Breaks through the enemy in front of you by charging with the bow held firmly before you.

skills.name: Mortal Blow
skills.description: Chance to deal additional damage to an enemy and recover HP & MP.

skills.name: Evasion Boost
skills.description: Grants a chance to dodge enemy attacks. If you succeed, attacks you land in the next second will result in Critical Hits. Also increases Knockback Resistance and Max HP permanently.

skills.name: Aggressive Resistance
skills.description: When attacking, create a barrier for a short time that reduces a percentage of incoming damage. Every attack creates a new barrier.

skills.name: Marksmanship
skills.description: When attacking, ignores a portion of enemy Defense. Permanently increases your Damage.

skills.name: Empowered Arrows
skills.description: Empowers certain attack skills as you use them. Enhances Piercing Arrow (Piercing Arrow II is unaffected).

skills.name: Reckless Hunt: Crossbow
skills.description: Reduces Avoidability and instead increases Critical Damage.

skills.name: Frostprey
skills.description: Temporarily summons a Frostprey. This skill is not affected by enemy damage reflection skills. Also increases Defense.

skills.name: Pain Killer
skills.description: Consumes a prepared Herb to become temporarily invincible. The skill can be canceled by using it again.\nNot affected by cooldown reset. Also increases Elemental Resistance and Status Resistance permanently.

skills.name: Empowered Piercing Arrow
skills.description: Rip through enemies with an empowered piercing arrow.

skills.name: Bolt Burst
skills.description: Fires arrows in all directions, striking multiple enemies nearby.

skills.name: Blink Bolt
skills.description: Mark the spot where you are currently standing. Use the skill again to ride a magical bolt back to that spot instantly. Use the skill again while holding the Down Arrow key to replace your original marker.

skills.name: Arrow Blink
skills.description: Activation Dummy

skills.name: Crossbow Expert
skills.description: Increases Crossbow Mastery, Attack Power, and Critical Damage.

skills.name: Illusion Step
skills.description: Greatly increases your DEX and Avoidability, and reduces damage taken. Also increases Knockback Resistance permanently.

skills.name: Bolt Surplus
skills.description: Increases the number of attacks for all multi-hit skills and final damage. Does not apply to Summon, 5th Job Common, or certain skills.

skills.name: Last Man Standing
skills.description: Increase the attack's power by training your strong, indomitable mind.

skills.name: Piercing Arrow II
skills.description: Enhances Piercing Arrow. Upon striking the first foe, your Piercing Arrow now fragments, dealing damage to additional enemies.

skills.name: Greater Empowered Arrows
skills.description: Enhances the strength of your Empowered Arrows.\nEmpowered Piercing Arrow is enhanced to Empowered Piercing Arrow II, and Empowered Arrows can also be used during Snipe.\nStriking an enemy with Empowered skills grants you the Marked Target buff, which is unaffected by duration increases. Permanently increases Final Damage and Ignore Defense.

skills.name: Sharp Eyes - Persist
skills.description: Increases Sharp Eyes's duration.

skills.name: Sharp Eyes - Guardbreak
skills.description: Grants Sharp Eyes a bonus to Enemy DEF Ignored.

skills.name: Sharp Eyes - Critical Chance
skills.description: Increases the Critical Rate of Sharp Eyes.

skills.name: Piercing Arrow - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases damage of Piercing Arrow, Piercing Arrow II, Arrow Fragments, Empowered Piercing Arrow, and Empowered Piercing Arrow II.

skills.name: Piercing Arrow - Spread
skills.description: Increases the max number of enemies hit by Piercing Arrow, Piercing Arrow II, Empowered Piercing Arrow, and Empowered Piercing Arrow II. Doesn't apply to the Arrow Fragments generated when Piercing Arrow lands.

skills.name: Piercing Arrow - Extra Strike
skills.description: Increases the number of attacks of Piercing Arrow, Piercing Arrow II, Arrow Fragments, Empowered Piercing Arrow, and Empowered Piercing Arrow II.

skills.name: Snipe - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases damage of Snipe, Empowered Snipe, and of Snipe's additional hits.

skills.name: Snipe - Boss Rush
skills.description: Increases boss damage of Snipe, Empowered Snipe, and of Snipe's additional hits.

skills.name: Snipe - Extra Strike
skills.description: Increases the number of attacks of Snipe, Empowered Snipe, and of Snipe's additional hits.

skills.name: Maple Warrior
skills.description: The Goddess of Maple World's grace increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Goddess of Maple World appear.

skills.name: Sharp Eyes
skills.description: Temporarily grants party members the ability to locate an enemy's weak spot to deal fatal damage to that enemy.

skills.name: Snipe
skills.description: Fires a carefully-aimed shot that inflicts massive damage. Targets the enemy with the highest Max HP within range. Marks the target, causing future Empowered Snipe attacks against it to deal additional damage.

skills.name: Hero's Will
skills.description: Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec. after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Does not apply Combat Orders.\nCan be used while using other skills.

skills.name: Arrow Illusion
skills.description: Summons an arrow illusion for a short time to draw enemies in and damage them. If you get hit during the skill, you will launch a powerful counterattack. Enemies will break free from the illusion if they have not attacked for a period of time. Not affected by attack reflection. Also increases Ignore Defense permanently.

skills.name: Marked Target
skills.description: You mark your targets in advance, granting you additional Ignore Defense and Final Damage for a short time.

skills.name: Empowered Piercing Arrow II
skills.description: Penetrate enemies with an enhanced piercing arrow. The arrow explodes at the point where it disappears, and fragments scatter to attack nearby enemies.

skills.name: Empowered Snipe
skills.description: Fires a carefully-aimed shot to deal severe damage. Targets the enemy with the highest max HP within range.

skills.name: Piercing Arrow II
skills.description: Your continued training allows you to wield a more powerful version of Piercing Arrow. Upon striking their first foe, your Piercing-type skills now fragment, dealing damage to additional enemies.

skills.name: High Speed Shot
skills.description: Fires off a focused shot that pierces all enemies within range.

skills.name: Epic Adventure
skills.description: Call upon the bravery deep within to increase damage output.

skills.name: Bullseye Shot
skills.description: Hone in on the enemy's weak spot for a devastating shot.

skills.name: Fury of the Wild
skills.description: Temporarily infuses Phoenix, Frostprey, and Shadow Raven with mysterious power for a devastating attack. Can only be used when either Phoenix, Frostprey, or Shadow Raven are summoned.

skills.name: Surge Bolt
skills.description: Concentrate and deploy a powerful spirit arrow.\nCan be activated while using Full Burst Shot after using Snipe, Piercing Arrow, High Speed Shot, and Repeating Crossbow Cartridge. However, you need to use up all of your arrows to use Full Burst Shot.\nAlso, if this skill hits the enemy, obtain the Marked Target buff.

skills.name: Repeating Crossbow Cartridge
skills.description: Use a special cartridge that allows you to fire multiple arrows at once. Use the skill again to activate a Full Burst Shot with the same cartridge. Full Burst Shot is attracted to the targeted enemy within range and attacks the boss with the highest HP first. Successful hits with Full Burst Shot grannts the Marked Target buff.

skills.name: HEXA Final Attack
skills.description: When a direct attack skill lands, there's a chance to trigger additional hits. Must have a crossbow equipped.\nIn addition, it permanently boosts HEXA Snipe.

skills.name: HEXA Snipe
skills.description:
Fires a carefully-aimed shot to deal severe damage.
Also, Empowered Arrows for Snipe are enhanced. Striking an enemy with Snipe prepares the second Snipe with Empowered Arrows and the fourth Snipe with 2 more special Ultimate Arrows.
When Snipe hits, the enemy's weaknesses are analyzed then marked. When attacking a marked enemy with Empowered Arrows, the enemy's weakness is exploited to fire an additional attack.
Snipe and Snipe enhanced with Empowered Arrows target the enemy with the highest Max HP first.

skills.name: HEXA Empowered Snipe
skills.description: Fires a carefully-aimed shot to deal severe damage.\nTargets the enemy with the highest Max HP within range first.\nFuture attacks against a marked target deal additional damage.

skills.name: Ultimate Snipe
skills.description: Pierces the enemy's vital points with the ultimate sniping skill.\nTargets the enemy with the highest Max HP within range first.\nFuture attacks against a marked target deal additional damage.

skills.name: HEXA Piercing Arrow
skills.description:
Fires an arrow. Its effect increases with each enemy it hits.
Empowered Arrow is further strengthened so that when Piercing Arrow hits, the Empowered Arrow is used for the second Piercing Arrow and Ultimate Arrow is activated for the fourth Piercing Arrow.
When Piercing Arrow hits an enemy, arrow fragments scatter along the attack path, hitting additional enemies that Piercing Arrow did not penetrate.
Additionally, permanently enhances HEXA Snipe.

skills.name: HEXA Empowered Piercing Arrow
skills.description: Penetrates enemies with an enhanced piercing arrow. The arrow explodes at the point where it disappears, and fragments scatter to attack nearby enemies.

skills.name: HEXA Ultimate Piercing Arrow
skills.description: Penetrates enemies with an ultimate piercing arrow. The arrow powerfully explodes at the point where it disappears, and fragments scatter to attack nearby enemies.

skills.name: HEXA Frostprey
